title: upgrade attention kernels: flashattn-v2 + fused-ops + rope/rotary tweaks + scheduling/kv-batching
author: Sofia Martinez
description: Motivation: Improve transformer inference throughput and memory efficiency across long-context workloads by upgrading to FlashAttention-v2 kernels, adding fused attention ops for common rotary/rope patterns, and feeding scheduler hints to the continuous-batching/KV-cache layers. This PR replaces the legacy attention path with FlashAttnV2 where available, adds a fused rotary/rope pre-rotate kernel to avoid redundant CUDA kernels at inference time, and exposes scheduling knobs so the runtime can select kernel variants based on sequence length, head dim, and KV cache locality. Changes include: kernel portability shims for older GPUs, runtime dispatch logic to choose between classic, flashattn-v2, and fused-rope kernels, a small API bump to expose kernel preferences in model runtime configs, unit + perf tests and benchmarking harness updates. Backwards compatibility: no model config changes are required; we default to previous behavior on unsupported hardware. Rollout plan: staged rollout behind a runtime feature flag gated by node pool labels, run perf canary across short/medium/long contexts, monitor latency P95 and memory tail. See linked Linear tickets for benchmarking thresholds and rollback criteria.
commits_summary: 7 commits: initial flashattn-v2 integration; add fused-rope kernel; runtime dispatch and scheduling hooks; KV batching hint propagation; unit tests + CI updates; perf harness updates; docs and migration notes.
benchmarks_summary: Microbenchmarks on A100: +1.18x throughput on 8k tokens, +1.05x on 2k tokens; P95 latency reduced 12% for long-context streaming; memory peak reduced ~28% for fp16 models due to lower intermediate allocation and fused ops. End-to-end e2e canary (small customer set) saw 9-12% token-cost reduction due to better batching and fewer kernel launches.
tests: Added unit tests for fused-rope correctness against golden CPU impl, integration tests to verify dispatch correctness across GPU families, and regression tests exercising KV-batching hint propagation. CI matrix covers CUDA 11.8/12.1 and cuDNN combos used in infra.

release_notes: Performance: Upgrade attention kernels to FlashAttention-v2 with fused rotary/rope optimizations and scheduler-aware dispatch. Improves throughput and reduces memory on long-context workloads. Rollout: feature-flagged; no customer-facing config changes.
